Rahul Gandhi meets President, claims vote rigging allegations not denied

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi met with President Droupadi Murmu and stated that the President did not deny allegations of vote rigging, but asked for proof. Gandhi also claimed that the President said she would look into the matter. Following the meeting, Gandhi posted on X, asserting that "Gyanesh [Kumar] will go, this government will go." He criticized the BJP, Congress, and INDIA alliance, alleging attempts to destabilize the country. Other leaders, including Nitin Naveen and Sudhanshu Trivedi, reacted strongly to Gandhi's statements, accusing him of trying to destabilize the nation with foreign support and questioning the opposition's stance.
